{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-wy-c","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"189a02733db8a0496c36a0aaebdcd480feab37d86c1cfe2abece404ee46e3493","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-wy-class-c:lineage:19","source_registry_sha256":"f2806994ac56e29c3588fb4e8e2cc870c5f64d0616933994765d31d7841ccbe9","source_liveness_sha256":"e9e98c5695424e30c400f1e14b2593178d09ca723f8f00581c9655dcae32ca6c"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C2"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C2","chunk_id":"C2.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Safety belts and child restraints — C2.01","heading":"C2 — Safety belts and child restraints","learner_facing":false,"markdown":"## C2 — Safety belts and child restraints
FACT_ID: sec05-R01 | anchor: A01
The handbook's belt-positioning booster guidance describes protection for a child over 40 pounds and directs the reader to the booster's individual height and weight limits. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec05-R02 | anchor: A01
When a vehicle headrest is available, the booster guidance recommends a low-back belt-positioning booster with the headrest adjusted behind the ears at the middle of the child's head. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec05-R03 | anchor: A01
Without a vehicle headrest, the guide recommends a high-back belt-positioning booster to protect the child's head. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec05-R04 | anchor: A01
The guide supports booster use with a lap-and-shoulder belt, while a lap-only belt requires consideration of other options. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec05-R05 | anchor: A01
For a seat belt to fit, the child's back and buttocks must remain against the vehicle seat back. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec05-R06 | anchor: A01
For proper belt fit, the shoulder belt must stay on the shoulder and snug across the chest while the lap belt sits low over the hip or upper thigh. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec05-R07 | anchor: A01
A child meeting the seat-belt fit criteria must be able to bend the knees fully over the vehicle-seat edge. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec05-R08 | anchor: A01
The seat-belt fit criteria require feet flat on the floor and the ability to remain comfortably in that position for the whole trip. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec05-R09 | anchor: A02
A person with a physician's written statement that a belt is inadvisable for physical or medical reasons is exempt from belt use. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec05-R10 | anchor: A02
A person in a passenger vehicle that federal law does not require to have safety belts is exempt from wearing one. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec05-R11 | anchor: A02
A United States Postal Service worker performing postal-carrier duties is exempt from the belt requirement. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec05-R12 | anchor: A02
A person properly secured in a child safety-restraint system need not separately wear a safety belt. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec05-R13 | anchor: A02
A front-seat occupant is exempt from belt use when the driver or passengers are already using all operable safety restraints in the vehicle. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0032]
